newsitem.title: USA: Sykes Enterprises offers 3.255 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sykes Enterprises offers 3.255 mln shrs.

text.p: Sykes Enterprises Inc said Friday its public offering of 3,255,000 shares of common stock has been declared effective by the Securities and Exchanged Commission, and has been priced at $46 per share.
Of the shares being offered, 1,553,320 are being offered by the company and the balance are being offered by certain shareholders.

Sykes said it intends to use the proceeds to open additional customer support centers, to make additional capital expenditures, and for working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions.
Sykes, an information technology outsourcing company, completed its initial public offering in April.
